phases.note: Before: an artifact-only grant called the decision provider through a group named `decisions`, and confirmWithCommand confirmed while plan.commandId differed from effectCommandId. Now group names are bound to their source-kind family before any provider read (composition_invalid, reads=0), and confirmWithCommand refuses plan/effect or plan/conversation mismatch with plan_mismatch, leaving the proposal pending with no effectCommandId.

Custom groups validated before reads: unknown/duplicate name, duplicate priority, non-positive/non-integer priority, empty/duplicate kinds, kind outside the name family, share outside [0,1] or NaN/±Infinity. Budget still clamped by grant and caller; expiry/purpose/confirmedAt and mid-await rechecks preserved; scan_incomplete fatal; explicit truncation separate.

Main's plan+commit+prepareCommand/commitPrepared stays authoritative. C consumers verify decision/work confirmation, reject terminal state, missing inputs inert, revision without current work refused, source/grant/preview drift rejected, same-body receipt replay identical, same command id with another body rejected, different effect id conflicts, receipt failure rollback+retry and reopen. The C-only confirmWithCommand helper now enforces the same command identity and is not used by main.

Real A-port consumer recipe: project/files via LocalProjectSourcePort, effective decisions via decisionContextProvider, conversation via store.product.messages.page, artifacts via ports.index.listArtifacts. Output includes stable manifest (sourceId/kind/group/path/contentDigest/baselineCommit/truncated/bytes/tokens/trust), preview, omitted, injectionFlagPaths and budgetClamped; no absolute paths, no actor/tool fields; expired/wrong-purpose/executor grants refused before reading.
